lb-world-bekaa-valley.basis: Lebanon has no delimited appellations yet (Law 216/2000; none delimited by the INVV). Regions follow the cazas.
lb-world-bekaa-valley.outline: Built from the administrative units that contain the area. The legal boundary follows other lines (roads, rivers, farms or altitude), so the real area is smaller.
lb-world-bekaa-valley.atlas_note: High plateau between the Lebanon and Anti-Lebanon mountains at about 1,000 m, where nearly all Lebanese wine is made.
